query: Tap the inline preview and bring a full-size control panel up from below, darkening the conversation that is still visible behind.

candidates.title: Open a full sheet over a dimmed conversation
candidates.moves: A white sheet carrying its grabber, heading and controls rises over the chat and settles. The retained conversation dims and shifts slightly.
candidates.staysFixed: The surrounding white stage stays fixed and the inline card remains under the sheet. The phone silhouette is nearly fixed.

candidates.title: Swipe through stacked attachments in a chat
candidates.moves: The top attachment moves sideways across the card edges. Independently offset artwork beneath it becomes the next top attachment.
candidates.staysFixed: Conversation header, message copy, composer and stack anchor stay in place.
